status: PREPARED; local source-bound checks passed; new native device acceptance not yet performed
changes: About, Verification, Business Inbox and Campaigns now subscribe to palette changes, use readable paired text/surfaces, and render status chrome from the active theme.

About displays nativeApplicationVersion/nativeBuildVersion from installed expo-application; it shows an explicit unavailable fallback instead of inventing1.0.0(100). Version tests use controlled metadata, not a new installed binary.

Source-inspected canvas headings, empty states, timestamps, field labels, unknown/error text and fixed-button labels use readable pairs. Error roles and status backgrounds remain; data operations are unchanged.

Fixed light cards keep compatible dark ink. Channel/community role chips receive an explicit light fill where their actual parent is a fixed light card/modal, preventing the lightsOut opaque hairline from conflicting with navy text.

Selected media badges keep a dedicated fixed white/yellow-on-black-scrim pairing. Changed scrims are checked over both black and white underlying pixels; images, gradients and movie behavior are unchanged.
New theme subscriptions select only the existing palette state. No new timers, queries, cache, authentication work or navigation action was introduced.

measuredColorPairs.scope: Actual palette and themedSheet factories; controlled actual component renders for four core screens, actual JSX/theme-binding fragments for additional subscriptions/status bars, and inspected explicit pairs. No native pixel/font/layout acceptance.

lineEndings.reason: Existing files contained mixed CRLF/LF. Only these four touched files were normalized to LF so new lines pass git diff --check. No action semantics changed.

providerBoundary.scope: AST-extracted Supabase, LocalAuthentication and navigation/nav invocations are byte-equivalent after CRLF normalization; this is not a whole-program behavior proof.

remaining.reason: Controls and ripple text are over native video and transparent/translucent layers. The static nearest-root calculation cannot establish actual per-frame contrast. Existing inverse-ink/media-palette interaction still needs a dedicated visual review; no claim that this media chrome is repaired.
A sibling image and LinearGradient sit behind the labels. The original tile-fill comparison is insufficient; no source or pixel acceptance of those gradient-backed labels in this batch.
The large decorative star has an adjacent readable No starred messages heading and explanatory text. Its color is retained; the raw low-contrast observation remains in the ledger.

auditCorrections: 18 original NaN observations came from four-digit alpha hex (#000a/#000c); the focused parser handles3/4/6/8-digit hex and rgba without treating nonfinite output as a product failure.

Eight original failures disappear after using actual opaque ancestors or ScrollView contentContainerStyle: fixed light channel/community cards, the navy email-verification success surface, the Market order modal surface and the navy call hero.

Three ContactSupport candidate observations are resolved by the parent-owned Support repair and are not attributed to this45-file batch. Ticket/Support runtime coverage stays in its separate parent receipt.

reactReview.result: No new effect dependency, asynchronous orchestration or provider mutation introduced. useTheme subscriptions use the existing primitive palette selector; existing action callbacks are retained. Fixed media palettes are not replaced wholesale.
reactReview.limitations: Controlled render hosts do not implement native reconciliation or measure frame timing. Existing55 scoped ESLint warnings remain identical to literal2f; no suppressions/new warnings were introduced.

limits: This is a bounded theme/readability repair, not a claim that every visual state in the app has passed. The original sweep skipped760 unresolved nodes and did not cover all runtime conditions.
The383 repaired entries are repeated style/site/palette observations. They are not383 separately tapped controls.
The111-case total includes104 new cases plus7 existing cases; baseline failures and repeated intermediate runs are not added to that total.
Opaque and scrim colors are computed for resting styles. Native text rasterization, font scaling, animation, pressed opacity and varying gradient/video pixels require device visual acceptance.
No MemoryAlbumScreen, MemoryFilm, MemoryMovieExport, native flow, compiler, provider, ref or main-report edits are part of this batch.
